requirement: When several products tie for the highest revenue in a region, return all of them instead of only the one with the smallest name: one (region, product, revenue) tuple per tied product, in ascending code-point order of product name, still grouped by region in ascending region order.
desc: A sale's revenue is units * price_cents. Sum revenue per (region, product) pair over all sales. For each region that has at least one sale, in ascending code-point order of region name, return (region, product, revenue) for the product with the highest total revenue in that region; if several products tie for the highest, return one tuple for each of them, in ascending code-point order of product name, before moving on to the next region.

decls.ts: type Sale = { region: string; product: string; units: number; price_cents: number };
